revision_history.change_rationale: Refined connection routing, official resources and semantic micro-motion after prior visual rejection.
Added semantic legend and synchronized Engineering labels to routed SVG paths.
Added generic connection-centric Engineering behavior, but the active KAYAS T02 NORMALIZED_HINTS service-domain model prevented the expected spine/leaf engineering composition.

User browser screenshots showed that T02 remained service/capacity-centric rather than engineer-readable spine/leaf connectivity. Added a mode-specific optional engineering profile so Presentation T02 can retain the 210-cabinet service-domain story while Engineering T02 renders device-role connectivity without mutating the canonical graph.

observations: T00 is visually readable and suitable as a navigation map.
T01 remains suitable as an executive architecture view but is not the target engineering connectivity view.

T02 Engineering displayed the 210-cabinet service-domain NORMALIZED_HINTS model (shared fabric, colocation demarcation, AI fabric and OOB) and did not expose the physical-device role chain expected by a network engineer.
T03 correctly showed 0 canonical physical relationships and explicitly stated that physical connectivity is not yet evidenced; no ports, optics, speeds or A/B paths were invented.
T04 is evidence-safe but intentionally sparse.
T05 provides useful management/OOB context but does not substitute for a dedicated T02 spine/leaf engineering composition.

T06 appropriately carries the service and capacity model, reinforcing that the 40+80+80 plus AI10 commercial/service story belongs primarily in the service/capacity view rather than being the only T02 engineering representation.

iteration_4b_changes: Added optional package resource engineering_profiles; projects without the resource keep existing behavior.
KAYAS T02 Engineering now has a dedicated device-role profile independent of the Presentation-mode 210-cabinet service-domain layout.

The KAYAS Engineering profile includes explicit External/Carrier context, Security/Application Delivery, Edge/Interconnect, Spine/Fabric Core, Leaf/Storage Access, Compute/Storage Endpoints and Management/OOB/Analytics lanes.
The profile references existing normalized objects and existing presentation-intent IDs; it does not create new canonical objects or relationships.
External/Carrier is represented as a non-canonical context node because router/carrier implementation details are not confirmed in the active package.
Pair quantities are shown as QTY only; no A/B member identity, HA protocol, peer link, ring, MLAG, IRF, port, speed or optic is inferred.

Existing design intents such as Security Service Chain, Interconnect to Fabric, Spine to Leaf Fabric, Compute Access, Storage Data Path, OOB to Fabric, Fabric Control and Fabric Telemetry are rendered as dashed DESIGN paths.
No arrowhead is added to design-intent paths; vertical role ordering communicates architecture without inventing confirmed directionality.
Engineering profile hover highlights only directly related nodes and paths and dims unrelated elements.
Engineering profile filters are view-only and do not mutate canonical data.
Haven loads the same generic overlay runtime but has no engineering_profiles resource, so the overlay is a no-op there.

KAYAS.note: The older 19-object / 5-relationship KAYAS fixture invariant belongs to the pre-service-model baseline and is superseded for active-package counts; its canonical records remain preserved within the expanded package.

manual_acceptance_required: Hard-refresh KAYAS preview and open T02 in ENGINEERING mode.

T02 Engineering must show the role sequence External/Carrier -> Security/Application Delivery -> Edge/Interconnect -> Spine/Fabric Core -> Leaf/Storage Access -> Compute/Storage Endpoints with Management/OOB/Analytics as a separate lane.
DC Fabric Spine Pair must be visibly tagged SPINE and Server/Tenant Leaf Pair must be visibly tagged LEAF.
Storage Network Switches must be visibly tagged STORAGE SW.
Dashed paths must be labelled DESIGN and remain clearly non-canonical.
The Engineering profile must show 0 canonical profile connections unless explicit relationship IDs are later added from evidence.
No router device, ring, HA/peer protocol, EVPN, VXLAN, port, speed or optic may appear unless supported by explicit package evidence.
T03 must remain unchanged in evidence discipline and continue to show zero evidenced physical connectivity.
Switching from ENGINEERING to PRESENTATION must restore the existing 210-cabinet T02 service-domain layout rather than deleting it.
Selecting an engineering-profile normalized device must continue to populate the shared DCTS Inspector.
Haven preview must remain visually unchanged because no Haven engineering profile is configured.
KAYAS and Haven production viewers must remain unchanged.
notes: Iteration 4 browser evidence was sufficient to reject T02 as the final engineering topology even though T03 evidence discipline was correct. Iteration 4B separates presentation/service topology composition from engineer-oriented device-role topology composition through an optional package resource. This checkpoint is not a runtime PASS; explicit user browser acceptance remains mandatory before production promotion.
